protocol.description:
Forecast-only LoRA adaptation and native LIBERO task evaluation.

This is a reconstruction of the released CALVIN observation-loss/LoRA recipe
for LIBERO, NOT a reproduction of the missing official ttt_libero.py. The
successful local native wrapper supplies the observation/action codec.
All arms replay the same recorded Clean actions. Only the adaptation text or
attention mask changes; deployment always restores native mask/original Goal.

Run --self-test on CPU before inference. The default run first measures Frozen
and CleanTTT on init 0/1/2, and stops before attack evaluation if CleanTTT loses
any Frozen success. Subsequent arms can reuse --data-cache and an accepted
--clean-gate-summary. Existing artifacts are never overwritten or deleted.
protocol.clean_goal: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
protocol.swap_goal: put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket
protocol.cpu_scope: Separate CPU Frozen/TTT baseline; CUDA source actions used only for fixed-data replay. CPU and CUDA success/gradient results must not be pooled as paired conditions.

lora.implementation: explicit torch LinearLoRA; same A/B equation/init as PEFT, not PEFT execution

optimizer.schedule: single non-warmup update at configured lr; no later scheduler-dependent update

protocol.loss: 0.1 * mean(primary/wrist MSE), CLIP RGB patches, no per-patch whitening, no policy loss
protocol.adaptation_mode: Qwen backbone train; frozen vision/CLIP/decoder eval; LoRA dropout zero
protocol.forecast_evaluation_rng: seed 20261014 + window start, reset for every pre/post/arm query
protocol.deployment: Original task Goal and native mask for every condition; no swap/cut persists at inference
protocol.scope: Reconstructed forecast-only LIBERO LoRA adapter; official ttt_libero.py absent. Fixed Clean-trajectory collection replaces exploratory sampling. Source-init evaluation is a development test; other evaluation init IDs are independent of adaptation trajectory.

data.preprocessing: Raw native env RGB -> model.image_processor (CLIP); no rotation, no per-patch whitening

scientific_scope: Verified fixed-control replay and CPU preprocessing only; no task success-rate or attack/defense result.
